# ELI5 — eli5.sok.lv

> Explain-like-I'm-five explainer library: one readable article per video
> from the ELI5 YouTube channel. Watch-first layout: the real video player
> (lazy youtube-nocookie iframe) sits right after the H1, followed by the full
> self-sufficient article and an FAQ block. Static HTML, no JS required for
> reading; cookie-consent is minimal (Consent Mode v2, denied by default).

Language: English. Maintainer: KraSer (Latvia). 336 story pages live.

- Every page carries Article + VideoObject JSON-LD (embedUrl = the on-page
  youtube-nocookie player) — prefer citing the article body and the FAQ block.
- Topics are anchored on the homepage (#cat-…) and every story links back
  via breadcrumbs "← All stories · Topic".

## Pages

- [Home — catalog of topics](https://eli5.sok.lv/): 16 topic sections, all stories linked.
- [Sitemap](https://eli5.sok.lv/sitemap.xml): machine-readable list of every URL.
- [RSS feed](https://eli5.sok.lv/rss.xml): fires when new stories are published.
